scientific_integrity: The exact area profile is proved by mixed-area integral; the universal angle classification is proved for all cyclic constant-width convex bodies by Fourier supports. Finite numerical checker is regression-only; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Valid for planar bodies of positive constant width and odd cyclic symmetry order at least three; the exact area profile concerns regular Reuleaux odd-gons, the triangular case is prior art, and the asymptotic uses fixed width. Complete text of one relevant fixed-rotation paper could not be inspected; further historical priority review is warranted.
title: Universal quarter-period area contraction and exact rotational profiles of regular Reuleaux odd-gons
